279	 * `ZJK` — used by `--bg` to let `cat task.md | ccb --bg "summarize"`

292	      return
293	    }
294	    buf += chunk

296	  process.stdin.on('data', onData)

298	    const timer = setTimeout(() => resolve(true), timeoutMs)
299	    process.stdin.once('end', () => {

301	      resolve(false)
302	    })
303	    process.stdin.once('error', () => {
304	      clearTimeout(timer)
305	      resolve(false)
306	    })
307	  })
308	  process.stdin.off('data', onData)
309	  if (timedOut) return ''
310	  if (truncated) {

524	  const stdoutFd = openSync(join(jobDir, 'stdout.log'), 'a')

527	  // Resolve our own binary so the child runs the same ccb. Forward the

534	  // standalone binaries — see packages/cli/src/bg/spawnPty.ts for the
535	  // full incident write-up.

537	  const launcher = getDefaultLauncher({ pinToCurrentBinary: true })
538	  const cmd = launcher.cmd

548	  // - THYROX_JOB_DIR: ant compat marker recording the job's on-disk

554	    FORCE_COLOR: '3', COLORTERM: 'truecolor', BROWSER: 'true',

564	    stdio: ['ignore', stdoutFd, stderrFd],

571	  // the exec — bad binary path, missing dir, etc. Clean up the half-
572	  // written job dir + print the underlying error rather than leaving
573	  // an orphaned `unknown`-status entry that ps will keep showing.
574	  if (child.pid === undefined) {

577	      const timer = setTimeout(() => resolve('spawn failed (no error event)'), 200)
578	      child.once('error', (err: Error) => {
579	        clearTimeout(timer)
580	        resolve(err.message)
581	      })
582	    })

584	      `Failed to background ccb child: ${reason}\n  cmd: ${fullCmd.join(' ')}\n`,
585	    )

589	  const { readProcStart } = await import('@thyrox/daemon/bgWorkerRegistry.js')

591	    short, pid: child.pid, cmd: fullCmd, cwd: opts.cwd,
592	    startedAt: Date.now(), status: 'running',
593	    procStart: readProcStart(child.pid) || undefined,
594	    cliVersion: MACRO.VERSION,
595	  }
596	  writeJobMeta(meta)

598	  // Pretty hint output: cyan short, dim hints (ant 4649.js tw6).
599	  const d = (l: string, r: string) => chalk.dim(`  ${l.padEnd(26)}${r}`)

601	    [
602	      `backgrounded · ${chalk.cyan(short)}`,
603	      d('ccb ps', 'list sessions'),
604	      d(`ccb logs ${short}`, 'show recent output'),
605	      d(`ccb logs ${short} -f`, 'follow output live'),
606	      d(`ccb stop ${short}`, 'stop this session (SIGTERM)'),
607	      d(`ccb rm   ${short}`, 'remove the job directory'),
608	      '',
609	    ].join('\n'),
610	  )
611	  return short
612	}

668	  const stdoutPath = join(getJobDir(job.short), 'stdout.log')
669	  const stderrPath = join(getJobDir(job.short), 'stderr.log')
670	  const follow = args.includes('-f') || args.includes('--follow')
671	
672	  // --tail N: print only the last N lines and exit (or seed the follow
673	  // stream so a long-running job doesn't dump megabytes of backlog).
674	  let tailLines: number | undefined
675	  const tailIdx = args.findIndex(a => a === '--tail' || a === '-n')
676	  if (tailIdx >= 0) {
677	    const v = args[tailIdx + 1]
678	    if (!v) {

680	      process.exit(1)

705	    // implementation self-contained and platform-portable.

707	    let stderrPos = 0

712	        const fd = openSync(path, 'r')

720	      }

723	    if (tailLines !== undefined) {

725	        process.stdout.write(tailFile(stdoutPath, tailLines))

727	      }
728	      if (existsSync(stderrPath)) {

730	        stderrPos = statSync(stderrPath).size
731	      }
732	    } else {
733	      if (existsSync(stdoutPath)) stdoutPos = writeNew(stdoutPath, 0, process.stdout)
734	      if (existsSync(stderrPath)) stderrPos = writeNew(stderrPath, 0, process.stderr)

487	/**
488	 * Spawn a worker child process with the appropriate env vars.
489	 */
490	function spawnWorker(
491	  worker: WorkerState,
492	  dir: string,
493	  config: Record<string, string>,
494	  signal: AbortSignal,
495	): void {
496	  if (signal.aborted || worker.parked) return
497	
498	  worker.lastStartTime = Date.now()
499	
500	  const env: Record<string, string | undefined> = {
501	    ...process.env,
502	    DAEMON_WORKER_DIR: dir,
503	    DAEMON_WORKER_NAME: config.name,
504	    DAEMON_WORKER_SPAWN_MODE: config.spawnMode || 'same-dir',
505	    DAEMON_WORKER_CAPACITY: config.capacity || '4',
506	    DAEMON_WORKER_PERMISSION: config.permissionMode,
507	    DAEMON_WORKER_SANDBOX: config.sandbox || '0',
508	    DAEMON_WORKER_CREATE_SESSION: '1',
509	    THYROX_CODE_SESSION_KIND: 'daemon-worker',
510	  }
511	
512	  // Build the worker command: reuse the same entrypoint with --daemon-worker flag
513	  const execArgs = [
514	    ...process.execArgv,
515	    process.argv[1]!,
516	    `--daemon-worker=${worker.kind}`,
517	  ]
518	
519	  console.log(`[daemon] spawning worker '${worker.kind}'`)
520	
521	  const child = spawn(process.execPath, execArgs, {
522	    env,
523	    cwd: dir,
524	    stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
525	  })
526	
527	  worker.process = child
528	
529	  // Pipe worker stdout/stderr to supervisor with prefix
530	  child.stdout?.on('data', (data: Buffer) => {
531	    const lines = data.toString().trimEnd().split('\n')
532	    for (const line of lines) {
533	      console.log(`  ${line}`)
534	    }
535	  })
536	  child.stderr?.on('data', (data: Buffer) => {
537	    const lines = data.toString().trimEnd().split('\n')
538	    for (const line of lines) {
539	      console.error(`  ${line}`)
540	    }
541	  })
542	
543	  child.on('exit', (code, sig) => {
544	    worker.process = null
545	
546	    if (signal.aborted) {
547	      // Supervisor is shutting down, don't restart
548	      return
549	    }
550	
551	    if (code === EXIT_CODE_PERMANENT) {
552	      // ant 5170 — permanent_exit: worker signaled it should never be
553	      // respawned (e.g. unrecoverable config error). Park, don't retry.
554	      logEvent('tengu_daemon_worker_permanent_exit', {
555	        worker_kind: worker.kind,
556	        exit_code: String(code),
557	        signal: sig ? String(sig) : '',
558	      })
559	      console.error(
560	        `[daemon] worker '${worker.kind}' exited with permanent error — parking`,
561	      )
562	      worker.parked = true
563	      return
564	    }
565	
566	    const uptimeMs = Date.now() - worker.lastStartTime
567	
568	    if (isHealthyWorkerExit(code, uptimeMs)) {
569	      // Porte de `Ue.onExit`, rama sana (r===0 && n>=br): resetea la racha
570	      // y respawnea de inmediato, sin backoff.
571	      worker.consecutiveCrashes = 0
572	      console.log(
573	        `[daemon] worker '${worker.kind}' exited code=${code} sig=${sig} uptime=${uptimeMs}ms (clean) — respawning`,
574	      )
575	      spawnWorker(worker, dir, config, signal)
576	      return
577	    }
578	
579	    worker.consecutiveCrashes++
580	    const backoffMs = computeWorkerBackoffMs(worker.consecutiveCrashes)
581	
582	    // ant 5170 — worker_crash: every non-permanent, non-healthy exit fires
583	    // this. Porte de `Ue.onExit`: `i("tengu_daemon_worker_crash",
584	    // {consecutive, exit_code, uptime_ms, worker_kind})`.
585	    logEvent(
586	      'tengu_daemon_worker_crash',
587	      buildWorkerCrashEventMetadata({
588	        consecutive: worker.consecutiveCrashes,
589	        exitCode: code,
590	        uptimeMs,
591	        workerKind: worker.kind,
592	      }),
593	    )
594	
595	    console.log(
596	      `[daemon] worker '${worker.kind}' ${formatWorkerExitLogLine({
597	        code,
598	        signal: sig,
599	        uptimeMs,
600	        consecutive: worker.consecutiveCrashes,
601	        backoffMs,
602	      })}`,
603	    )
604	
605	    setTimeout(() => {
606	      if (!signal.aborted && !worker.parked) {
607	        spawnWorker(worker, dir, config, signal)
608	      }
609	    }, backoffMs)
610	  })
611	}

50	 * (upgrade, KILL+respawn). Sends `nudge` op repeatedly for up to 10s,
51	 * returning 'up' as soon as the daemon answers `restarting:false`. If
52	 * daemon stays unreachable returns 'down'.
53	 */
54	export async function nudgeDaemonSkew(): Promise<'up' | 'down'> {
55	  const start = Date.now()
56	  const deadline = start + 10_000
57	  let lastReason: 'restarting' | 'etimeout' | 'enoconn' = 'restarting'
58	  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
59	    const r = await daemonRequest('nudge', {}, { timeoutMs: 1000 })
60	    if (r.ok && r.op === 'nudge') {
61	      if (!(r as Record<string, unknown>).restarting) {
62	        if (Date.now() - start > 200) {
63	          logEvent('tengu_bg_skew_nudge', { converged: 'true', duration_ms: String(Date.now() - start) })
64	        }
65	        return 'up'
66	      }
67	      lastReason = 'restarting'
68	      await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 100))
69	      continue
70	    }
71	    if (!r.ok && r.code === 'ETIMEOUT') {
72	      lastReason = 'etimeout'
73	      await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 100))
74	      continue
75	    }
76	    if (!r.ok && r.code === 'ENOCONN') {
77	      lastReason = 'enoconn'
78	      await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 100))
79	      continue
80	    }
81	    return 'up'
82	  }

84	    converged: 'false',
85	    restarting: String(lastReason === 'restarting'),
86	    etimeout: String(lastReason === 'etimeout'),
87	    enoconn: String(lastReason === 'enoconn'),

139	  const ping = await daemonRequest('ping', {}, { timeoutMs: 1000 })
140	  const stateMeta = {
